author: CollinRugg
text:
Lindsay Clancy conspiracy theorist says she now believes Patrick Clancy is innocent after watching his interview.

“I just feel like he was like very genuine…”

Glad she is being deprogrammed but people who believe he killed his kids just because they saw videos from nut jobs on TikTok shouldn’t be voting in our elections.
